BiblicalUsage: Haziel is named among the sons of Shimei, a Levite, with Shelomith and Haran, three chiefs of the fathers of Laadan. He is named once, in the ordering of the Levites under David.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Levites are ordered by name because their service is ordered by God. Haziel's place among the chiefs of Laadan is his part in the worship.
